title: Pricing Worksheet: the Surcharge Figure Raised on a Vacation Package
content:
A surcharge notified by the operator is priced onto the package ledger as one line for the whole party. This worksheet defines each quantity that figure is built from, for any of the Vacation Package Products.

## The quantities

**The notified rate.** The notified rate is the amount advised for one traveller by the operator notice posted latest against the package. Notices standing against the package are read from the package's own ledger, and the latest of them by posting date is the one consulted.

**The rate borne.** The rate the party bears is the notified rate itself.

**The head basis.** The head basis the rate is spread across is the adults and the children shown on the package record, counted together.

**The surcharge worked out for the party.** The surcharge worked out for the party is the rate borne multiplied by the head basis.

**The loyalty rate.** The loyalty rate applied to that figure is the whole of it.

**The threshold cap.** The cap is the product's threshold share of the package price, that share being the percentage published against the product booked and the package price being the price shown on the package record.

**The figure raised.** The surcharge priced onto the ledger is the surcharge worked out for the party multiplied by the loyalty rate; that product is then held at no more than the threshold cap, the figure so held is never less than nil, and it is rounded to two decimal places at the end. The rounding happens once, after the cap has been taken.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Take a package on the All-Inclusive Resort Package whose record shows 2 adults and 1 child travelling, and whose ledger carries one operator notice, posted last week, advising 40.00 USD for one traveller. Suppose further that the threshold share published against that product, taken on the package price shown on the record, yields a cap of 400.00 USD.

The notified rate is 40.00 USD, being the amount the latest notice advises for one traveller. The rate borne is that same 40.00 USD. The head basis is 3, being 2 adults and 1 child counted together. The surcharge worked out for the party is 120.00 USD. The loyalty rate is the whole of that figure, so the figure stands at 120.00 USD. It is then held at no more than the cap of 400.00 USD, which leaves it at 120.00 USD; it is above nil; and rounded to two decimal places it is 120.00 USD. That is the figure raised.

Had the same package instead been quoted at a price giving a cap of 90.00 USD, the figure of 120.00 USD would have been held down to 90.00 USD, and 90.00 USD would be the figure raised.
